Context: 4. Block years and carry forward of L TC

block of two or four years.  
In respect of officials entitled to Home town LTC, the concession the official is  
can be carried forward to the first year of the next block only if entitled to a carried forward LTC to Home town for that year.  
Suppose an official is entitled to two concessions during  
Example.the two blocks of 2022-2023 and 2024-2025.
